name: The Way of Wine
source:
Ethan's parents grow concerned about him and propose a trip to the capital to meet his childhood friend and, perhaps, find love to secure the family's future.

On his journey, Ethan will cross paths with fascinating people and perhaps meet more potential brides, each with her own story to explore. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2489660/]Steam[/url]]
